meta.title: The Imperial Journey
meta.subtitle: What an Imperial player actually experiences, in order, with the exact words the game shows today.
meta.statusLine: Devotion.esp via houseCARL (Anvil / Devotion Dev / Devotion-V3Dev) + live-source Papyrus - 2026-08-25 - no runtime observation
caveats: PDV is NOT silent about state changes. Active Effects and the Survey carry a lot of good writing. The open question is which moments deserve a PUSH as well as the PULL that already exists.
Text below is a snapshot with provenance. Every line names its source so it can be re-checked; the ESP and Papyrus remain the authority.

acts.title: Act 1 - Becoming an Imperial
acts.intro: No setup choice by design. The civic Nine Divines lane auto-starts and the Concordat tension is named immediately.

beats.title: Origin start
beats.trigger: Origin captured on first load of a new character

lines.text:
You begin in the broad embrace of the Nine Divines, even as the White-Gold Concordat presses down on the open worship of Talos.

Live under the Divines. Your choices will decide how Talos, law, and public duty weigh on you.

beats.note: ONE box, not two: GetStartupInfoOnlyText joins the canonical summary and the Imperial followup with a blank line. Strong framing - the Concordat tension is named in the first thing an Imperial reads. Papyrus-emitted; no Imperial startup MESG exists in the ESP.

beats.title: Civic acts
beats.trigger: Public service, mercy, lawful order, honest work, death duty

lines.text: Your public service steadies your devotion.
Completed craft strengthened civic practice.
Civic Steadiness: Your public service steadies your devotion.
Civic duty lends order to your worship, even where public and private loyalties diverge.

beats.gap: WIRING then WRITING. Five civic families exist in code (public_service, mercy, lawful_order, honest_work, death_duty) but PDV_OriginRuntime_Imperial.psc:367 passes one hardcoded context string for all of them, so a mercy act reports as 'public service'. The families are wired for SCORING but not for TEXT. Fix needs both: a code change to select the line by family, then five lines written. Neither alone is enough.
beats.note: Repeat and capped acts are correctly silent (suppressed when grantedMetric <= 0).

beats.title: The civic substrate
beats.trigger: Same civic acts, one shared 4.0/day credit

lines.text: Civic practice steadies body and road. Maximum Health +5, Maximum Stamina +5.
The Empire's practiced disciplines hold under pressure. Maximum Health +10, Maximum Stamina +10.
Civic duty has become settled practice. Maximum Health +15, Maximum Stamina +15.

beats.gap: DESIGN, not a defect. The substrate script is deliberately quiet - every string in it is a trace or a storage key - so a tier crossing reaches the player only as the 'deepen' phase of the next favor toast, plus the new blessing appearing. That may be exactly right for an always-on cultural layer. The open question is whether crossing into Civic Discipline or Civic Exemplar deserves a beat of its own, or whether quiet is the point.
beats.note: Player-facing ladder: Civic practice quiet -> Civic Steadiness -> Civic Discipline -> Civic Exemplar. Decays at 3-day grace, -1/day, floor 20 (floor 0 while cursed).

acts.title: Act 2 - Being noticed
acts.intro: Tier crossings DO push - a Book of Days journal line. But one whole relationship can climb in total silence.

beats.title: Broad tier crossings
beats.trigger: Broad civic piety crossing a tier

lines.text: The Divines' Regard has reached Observant.
The Divines regard your shared worship. Poison Resistance +10%.
lines.surface: Active Effect - The Divines' Regard - Observant

lines.text: The Divines deepen their regard for your shared worship. Poison Resistance +10%, Disease Resistance +10%.

beats.note: Imperial's broad lane display name is 'The Divines' Regard'. Labels: Distant / Observant / Faithful. Caps at Tier 2 - a patron is required to go further.

beats.title: Patron tier crossings
beats.trigger: Patron piety crossing Seeker 25 / Devoted 50 / Champion 85

lines.text: Your devotion to <Deity> has reached <Seeker | Devoted | Champion>.

beats.gap: DESIGN. Two tier vocabularies run in parallel and disagree: the journal line says Seeker/Devoted/Champion, the toast band says Distant/Observant/Faithful/Devoted. 'Devoted' means a different position in each. Decide one vocabulary before writing anything that uses either.
beats.note: Design question: is the double vocabulary intended?

beats.title: Talos climbs in silence
beats.trigger: Any Talos tier crossing while Concordat standing is above 50
beats.gap: DESIGN, and it cuts both ways. Imperial Talos tier crossings are suppressed entirely while Concordat standing is above 50, so a compliant Imperial climbs Seeker, Devoted and Champion with Talos and is told nothing. Read one way this is a hole - a whole relationship progresses invisibly. Read the other way it is thematically exact: you are hiding this faith, so the game hides it too. Needs an owner ruling before any wiring or writing.
beats.note: The Concordat does not merely gate the offer - it makes the whole Talos relationship invisible. Evidence: PDV_DevotionLedger.psc:1155-1157 with PDV_OriginRuntime_Imperial.psc:238-248. The sharpest experiential hole in the Imperial journey.

acts.title: Act 3 - The Concordat, underneath everything
acts.intro: A parallel track that moves whenever the player acts politically. Zero text at the record layer.

beats.title: Where you stand
beats.trigger: Political acts adjust the standing track

lines.text: Under the Concordat, you are <label>.
Under the White-Gold Concordat, you are <label>.
lines.surface: Book of Days, on dawn mode change, pinned

lines.text: Imperial | <label> | <standing>
Civic faith, Divines, and Concordat pressure leave their marks here.

beats.gap: Every line RESTATES THE LABEL and none names the cost. The transition beat does fire at dawn - what is missing is content, not the beat.
beats.note: States: Openly Defiant / Privately Defiant / Uncommitted / Publicly Compliant / Concordat Enforcer. Record layer is entirely empty: the QUST has no Name, 0 stages, 0 objectives; the GLOB is a bare float.

beats.title: What compliance actually costs
beats.gap: Nothing anywhere states the cost. High compliance CLOSES Talos, blunts Stendarr and Arkay daily shift, and silences Talos tier crossings. The track is wired as Talos's GainModifyingTrack AND DecayModifyingTrack, so Talos piety gains slower and decays faster while you comply.
beats.note: Locked 2026-08-25: Talos offers fail gracefully, no offer-time rejection. State copy is therefore the ONLY channel carrying this - and it currently carries nothing. Owner copy in progress on the workbook's Concordat Writing sheet. Evidence: PDV__ManagerQuest.psc:1164-1168.

acts.title: Act 4 - The offer
acts.intro: Dawn-only gate: 50 piety plus qualifying signals on two separate days within seven. A vanilla MessageBox never shows the MESG Name - only the Description is read.

beats.title: Nine offers
beats.trigger: Commitment gate opens for an eligible Divine

lines.text: Your devotion has not wavered through upheaval. Carry the god of time as your own, and the long order becomes your faith. Will you?
You kept faith with me where the law forbade it. Carry the old breath openly, and the Empire's own god answers a treason of conscience. Will you?
You have built and mended where you could. Carry the mother of the people as your own, and the civic heart is yours to keep. Will you?
Your work is honest and your weight is true. Carry the trade-god as your own, and the day's labor becomes worship. Will you?
The open way has been kind to you. Carry Kynareth as your own, and the road and the sky answer. Will you?
You have kept the rites the war neglected. Carry Arkay as your own, and the death-cycle is your charge. Will you?
You have stayed the killing hand where the province wanted it loosed. Carry Stendarr as your own. Will you?
You study, you weigh, you judge with care. Carry Julianos as your own, and the written truth is your devotion. Will you?
You make beauty and speak well where it matters most. Carry Dibella as your own. Will you?

beats.gap: FOUR offers never name their god in the description - Akatosh ('the god of time'), Talos ('the Empire's own god'), Mara ('the mother of the people'), Zenithar ('the trade-god'). Since the Name field is not displayed, an Imperial offered Akatosh is never told it is Akatosh.
beats.note: Buttons on every offer, in order: Accept / Not yet / Refuse. Independently reproduces the wording backlog's Imperial count of four.

lines.text: You take this patron. The broad faith narrows to one, and the order keeps you as its own.
Not yet. Broad worship holds, and the patron waits on your word.
You keep to broad worship. The patronage is declined, and will not be offered again soon.

acts.title: Act 5 - The patron road
acts.intro: Nine three-rung blessing ladders, all pull, all written. The Talos ladder tracks secrecy into openness - the only place the political arc is currently written.

beats.title: The ladders

lines.text: Defiance held in secret hardens you. Armor +15.
Open faith in the Ninth steels your arm. Armor +30, One-Handed +8.
The Hero-God of Man stands with the faithful. Armor +50, One-Handed +20.
Arkay's ward stands between you and the grave. Disease Resistance +27%, Maximum Health +30.

beats.note: All nine Divines have full Seeker/Devoted/Champion ladders with written descriptions.

beats.title: Champion

lines.text: Your devotion to <Deity> has reached Champion.

beats.gap: DESIGN first, then wiring and writing. No Imperial champion-entry record exists in any type - 'Champion' appears solely as a blessing tier suffix, so the apotheosis moment gets the same sentence as every other tier crossing. Only Nord/Kyne has a real entry message anywhere in the mod, so the decision is the shared architecture: one parameterised transition for all races and deities, or bespoke moments.
beats.note: This is the shared champion-entry gap: only Nord/Kyne has a real entry message anywhere in the mod.

branches.title: Neglect
branches.trigger: Civic metric above 0 AND more than 3 days since a civic source

lines.text: You have let civic faith lapse. The Divines' ward against sickness thins -- Disease Resistance -5% until you return to public service. The real bite comes only at rupture or curse.
lines.surface: Active Effect - The Divines Grow Distant

lines.text: A rite has grown quiet and needs attention.
You return to a rite you had let fall silent.

branches.gap: WIRING then WRITING. No Imperial-specific push exists: SyncImperialNeglectSpell emits no toast, no Book entry, no message, and the generic dawn 'Devotion quiet' toast is gated to Nord (PDV_DevotionLedger.psc:2212), so a broad-worship Imperial gets nothing at all at onset or recovery. The pull text is good and honest; only the moment is missing.
branches.note: The pull text is good and explains the mechanic honestly.

branches.title: Curse - vampirism and lycanthropy
branches.trigger: Vampirism or lycanthropy contracted or cured

lines.text: Curse posture: the civic faith is halted while the undeath holds.
Curse posture: the civic faith runs strained while the beast is in you.
Curse posture: the civic faith is whole again, but the community religion remembers the absence.
A curse changes the shape of devotion.
The curse lifts, and devotion may answer again.

branches.gap: WIRING then WRITING. GetCurseContextForRace (PDV_OriginRuntimeBase.psc:7504-7538) has branches for Nord, Altmer, Bosmer, Argonian and Orc but NO Imperial branch, so at the moment a curse halts civic devotion the player gets only the bare generic line. No Imperial CurseState record exists. The Survey posture sentences are Imperial-specific and well written - they just require the player to go looking.
branches.note: Mechanically the curse halts civic devotion, wipes the substrate and seeds recovery at 20 on cure - all correct, all announced only if the player opens the Survey.

branches.title: The Daedric track
branches.trigger: Acts a Prince cares about; notice at piety 20, offer at 50

lines.text: <Prince> has taken notice of you.
lines.surface: Book of Days, heading 'A Prince takes notice'

branches.gap: WIRING ONLY - the writing is already done. 16 PDV_Msg_Daedric_*_Response_Imperial records exist, one per Prince, carrying the Imperial cultural reaction to that contact. They have no organic call site and fire only from debug. Written, race-specific content that no player has ever seen; nothing needs authoring, only a trigger.
branches.note: Universal track: silent accrual -> notice at 20 -> three commitment signals -> formal offer -> global consent -> Seeker/Devoted/Champion with paired Boon and Price spells. Owner-ruled backlog 2026-08-07.

survey.title: The full Survey readout
survey.intro: Assembled at PDV_OriginRuntime_Imperial.psc:489-527. The richest Imperial surface by a wide margin, and entirely pull.
base: <Deity> holds your focus among the Nine. Standing: <band>. <Concordat sentence>
You worship the Nine Divines broadly, and your standing is <band>. <Concordat sentence>
conditional: The commitment remains, but its boon is suspended until 50 piety.
You have kept Talos at hidden shrines, away from watching eyes.
You have honored Talos in the open, where the Concordat forbids it.
Your patron has taken note of the civic good you have done in their name.
You have drifted far enough on the Talos question that a deliberate change of course could now bring you back.

findings: Pull is strong, push is thin. Blessings, neglect, curse posture and the Survey are well written; the push layer is the startup box, favor toasts, tier journal lines, the offer and its answers.
Talos tier crossings are silenced while Concordat standing is above 50 - a whole relationship can reach Champion invisibly. The sharpest finding, and it was not previously in the audit queue.
Five civic families report as one string, and a mercy act reports as 'public service'.
Two tier vocabularies run in parallel and disagree on what 'Devoted' means.
The Concordat has zero record-layer text; its transition beat fires but only restates the label.
Champion gets the generic tier sentence - no Imperial recognition of any kind.
Broad-worship Imperials get no neglect push at all; that dawn toast is Nord-gated.
16 written Imperial Daedric responses are unreachable.
